Liang Wenjie is a foreigner: when he was interviewed on the radio by a highly qualified musician, Luo Daewoo, he criticized the party’s past struggle for freedom of speech, which now discourages people from speaking out, more frankly, that “the foreigners are being bullied enough” to cause controversy.
